newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Osprey Maritime requests shr suspension.
newsitem.headline: Osprey Maritime requests shr suspension.

text.p: Osprey Maritime said on Sunday it will make a request to the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) to suspend trading of its shares from Monday to clarify rumours about its buying of Gotaas-Larsen.
Osprey said in a statement that "the directors of Osprey have become aware of the certain rumours and reports in the press and wish to clarify the situation."

It added that "the company has a long term partnership with Gotaas-Larsen Ltd with which it has been exploring the possibility of closer cooperation. Talks are in progress. More specific annoucements will be made if and when appropriate."
"In light of this, the company will be requesting the SES to suspend trading in its shares from Monday, 12 May 1997," it said.

Speculation about a deal between the two has been growing for the past two weeks. The Asian Wall Street Journal on Friday quoted unnamed sources as saying that Osprey planned to buy Gotaas-Larsen, a London based shipping firm for US$500-$800 million.
Gotaas-Larsen declined to comment on Friday.
